name: Windows x64 Desktop App, Offline Waterjet PDF-to-DXF/DWG Studio & Native SolidWorks/NX
summary: Pro3DWorks v3 ships as a dedicated offline-first Windows desktop application with a 15-day full-feature trial, integrated SolidWorks & Siemens NX local bridge, and Waterjet CAD prep.

highlights.title: Waterjet PDF → DXF / DWG Studio
highlights.text: Extract vector contours or trace scanned blueprints with auto-deskew, refit Bézier curves to G1 biarcs, run True Overkill and Topology Doctor DFM, apply OMAX Q1–Q5 or SendCutSend R12 presets, and estimate cut time and garnet cost offline.

highlights.title: Native SolidWorks & Siemens NX bundled setup
highlights.text: Windows Desktop bundles the local loopback CAD Translation Bridge and provides a one-click in-app setup wizard (under explicit NVIDIA usd-convert-cad 0.3.0 license acceptance) for .SLDPRT, .SLDASM, and NX .prt assemblies.

highlights.title: 15-day full Pro trial + Free Basic Viewer
highlights.text: Every installation activates a no-card 15-day trial of all Pro tools via Ed25519 offline-capable tokens. After Day 15, upgrade on Pro Monthly ($29 founding), Yearly ($249), Shop 5-Pack, or Perpetual v3 ($599), or continue using the Free Basic 3D Viewer.

highlights.title: 3D B-Rep inspection, PMI, stack-ups & photoreal studio
highlights.text: 4-GiB OpenCascade kernel, SolidWorks-style 3-plane section triad with solid hatched caps, 1D Worst-Case/RSS/Monte Carlo tolerance stack-up, GPU path tracing, and local or cloud BYOK AI Engineer.

notes: All CAD geometry, PDF-to-DXF/DWG conversions, DFM checks, and GPU renders run locally on your workstation — zero customer model uploads.
OpenCascade / occt-import-js (LGPL-2.1) is shipped in separate relinkable desktop files alongside LICENSE.md.
Native SolidWorks (.SLDPRT/.SLDASM) and Siemens NX (.prt) viewing via NVIDIA usd-convert-cad 0.3.0 installs locally only after explicit operator I ACCEPT license consent.
